claims.explanation: Piperacetazine is a phenothiazine antipsychotic that directly binds and inhibits the PAX3::FOXO1 fusion transcription factor in alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma and also acts as a competitive inhibitor of squalene epoxidase (SQLE), disrupting cholesterol/lipid metabolism; its selective killing likely reflects dependence on these pathways plus dopamine-receptor/GPCR signaling and EGFR/RAS-MAPK-driven survival. The most sensitive lines are enriched for EGFR mutations/amplification, RAS-MAPK activation (NRAS, BRAF), and PI3K-PTEN pathway alterations, whereas resistant lines often lack these dependencies or carry ARID1A/SMARCA4 loss. Features predicting sensitivity therefore center on EGFR/RAS-MAPK activation and SQLE/cholesterol-pathway dependence.
